title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan

thread.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan • FX Senshi Kurumi-chan - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers found the episode darkly funny and compelling, especially its escalating tension and exaggerated trading situations.
Several commenters praised the character contrast, particularly the more cautious and grounded behavior of Yasuko.
Viewers appreciated the show's research and trading-focused detail, while some felt the characters' decisions were increasingly frustrating or implausible.
A recurring reaction was discomfort and anxiety because the characters repeatedly take reckless financial risks.
Mebuki drew substantial criticism for emotional, impulsive decisions, though some commenters viewed her as tragic rather than simply foolish.
